main_library.notes: Reviewed for the current public Moonshine runtime, model catalogue, tokenizer conversion, and decoding behavior. The current deployment library is ONNX-oriented and is not executed by VoiceHub.

architecture_reference.notes: Reviewed for the published Safetensors graph, raw-waveform frontend, rotary attention, masking, tied output projection, and teacher-forced loss semantics.

fine_tuning_reference.notes: Reviewed for raw-waveform collation, EOS-terminated targets without a label-side BOS token, decoder right shifting, ignored label padding, encoder-freezing, and curriculum-training guidance. VoiceHub integrates the loss-critical data semantics into its native processor and leaves optimizer, freezing, and curriculum policy to the general trainer.
